name: JB McGuire-Dix-Lakehurst
description: Joint Base McGuire-Dix-Lakehurst hosts the 87th Air Base Wing and provides global mobility, joint-service training, and supports multiple Army, Navy, and Air Force missions across three historic installations.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

events.title: Transition Assistance Program “TAP” Curriculum
events.description: Prepare for a successful transition from military to civilian life with this comprehensive multi-day Transition Assistance Program workshop. Service members and their families will receive valuable information, resources, and guidance to help navigate the next chapter with confidence. July 13-July 15, 7:45am-4:30pm, Military & Family Readiness Center, Bldg. 3435 Broidy Rd., JBMDL McGuire The TAP curriculum includes: Day 1: VA Benefits & Services Day 2: Managing Your Transition, Military Occupation Crosswalk, Personal Financial Readiness, and Unemployment Day 3: Department of Labor Employment W

events.title: Entrepreneur (Shark Tank) Camp
events.description: Think big, and pitch like a pro! 9:00am-12:00pm, August 3-August 7, Tommy B’s Community Activity Center, Bldg. 2705 East Arnold Avenue Future business leaders and innovators are invited to join this exciting entrepreneurship camp where campers will solve everyday problems, develop creative products, market their ideas, and sell to fellow campers while competing to earn the most Creator Bucks. Registration: CYPBMS Portal Cost / Eligibility: $25 per participant. Open to ages 9-18. Capacity limited to 25 participants. events.title: Intramural Kickball Starts
events.description: Get your team together and take the field for the Intramural Kickball League! Teams will compete throughout a two-month season, with games played on Thursdays. Letters of Intent (LOIs) are due September 16, 2026. For more information: 732.323.7266 amber.jones.28@us.af.mil

events.title: Basketball and Cheer Registration Opens
events.description: Basketball & Cheer Registration Opens Get ready for another exciting season of Youth Basketball and Cheer! Registration is open for eligible youth interested in hitting the court or cheering on their team this winter. Registration: October 5 – November 3, 2026 Season: January – March Falcon Courts North, Bldg. 3830 E. Scott Street Registration is available through the CYPBMS Parent Portal. The cost is $75 per youth and includes a team uniform. A current Sports Physical and proof of a current Flu Shot Record must be uploaded to your CYPBMS account prior to registration. New to CYPBMS? sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact All American Inn / Doughboy Inn (609-754-4667) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 87 FSS, MFRC, and official JB MDL sites for in-processing and joint base support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
